notes: tariffs: optional, per polity: a list of { target, product, rate }. target is a polity tag or "all"; product is a resource, an equipment type, consumerGoods, a class (resources, equipment, consumerGoods) or "all"; rate is a share, capped by the tariff ceiling. The starting rates are written by test/generate-tariffs.js from the starting relations and trade laws, and are re-run only by hand.
